Satellite CIRCUS (Characterization of the Ionosphere using a Radio receiver on a CUbeSat)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 2U
Status cancelled
Entity name Université Pierre et Marie Curie
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation France
Oneliner

Study in situ I / F layer of the ionosphere using a radio receiver and to measure the plasma power spectrum.
Description

Study in situ I / F layer of the ionosphere (enter 90 and 400 km) using a radio receiver and to measure the plasma power spectrum between 50 kHz and 50 Mhz using radio antenna and a TNR-HF receiver (Receiver Thermal Noise).
